meta.description: 1900 province → modern country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, lower case) and UN continental region under the province label point. P4 input (D-142).
meta.source: Natural Earth 1:10m Cultural Vectors, Admin 0 – Countries (public domain), cached by the M11 geometry build
meta.method: Point in polygon of the province's own point: its label when the label lies inside the province (some labels are off-map placeholders), otherwise the centroid of its largest ring (or that ring's first vertex). A point outside every country takes the country of the nearest boundary vertex (method *-nearest-boundary).
